# Sipiteno

> Strategic business development and technology consulting firm. We help technology companies expand internationally across 28 countries in Europe, Caucasus, Central Asia, and beyond. Founded 2009.

## Company Summary

Sipiteno combines 15+ years of regional expertise with hands-on technical delivery in AI consulting, business development, IT solutions, MicroSaaS MVP development, and digital marketing. We serve technology companies from early-stage startups to Fortune 500 enterprises.

- Website: https://sipiteno.com
- Contact: sales@sipiteno.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/sipiteno
- Founded: 2009
- Team Size: 20-30 professionals
- Languages: English, Russian, Ukrainian, Polish, Serbian, Georgian
- Client Rating: 4.9/5 (50+ reviews)
- Projects Delivered: 50+
- Years in Business: 17
